attempts.text: {"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Marxist Unity Group wants the DSA to free itself from the Democratic Party and all other capitalist influences.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Marxist Unity Group strives to transform the DSA into an independent socialist party.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Independence for the DSA means establishing a distinct public profile with its own platform, branding, and rhetoric.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Independence for the DSA means building its own institutions and its own party discipline in the halls of power.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Marxist Unity Group would stand with unwavering confidence in its cause and would not water down its socialist vision or subordinate its interests to those of a capitalist party.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"The Marxist Unity Group would cultivate a popular mandate for revolution by running militant socialist candidates for public office and simultaneously organizing grassroots institutions of working class power.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"The Marxist Unity Group would create party-affiliated media, community services, mutual aid and defensive organizations.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"Within the labor movement, the Marxist Unity Group would fight the existing labor bureaucracy, build militant and democratic unions, and strive to win these unions to socialist politics.", "claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[4]},{"claim_text":"As the Marxist Unity Group nurtures a vast ecosystem of socialist-allied institutions, the socialist party will simultaneously become a mass movement: a party-movement.", "claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[4]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
